name: Uncanny Luck
body:
The Gambler smiles on you and occasionally grants you boons.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is a god of luck

Benefit: Once per day you may reroll any one failed saving throw, skill check, ability check or attack roll. You must accept the results of the second roll, even if it is worse than the first roll.
